exam_scheme.note: The National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance Examination (NCHM JEE) is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of the National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology (NCHMCT), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India. NCHM JEE is the national gateway for admission to the 3-year Bachelor of Science in Hospitality and Hotel Administration (B.Sc. HHA) degree programme offered jointly by NCHMCT and Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) across Central, State, Public Sector, and Private Institutes of Hotel Management (IHMs). The examination is a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 180 minutes (3 hours) duration comprising 200 multiple-choice questions carrying a total of 800 marks (4 marks per question). The test contains five sections: Numerical Ability and Analytical Aptitude (30 questions, 120 marks), Reasoning and Logical Deduction (30 questions, 120 marks), General Knowledge & Current Affairs (30 questions, 120 marks), English Language (60 questions, 240 marks), and Aptitude for Service Sector (50 questions, 200 marks). Marking scheme: 4 marks awarded for each correct response, negative marking of 1 mark deducted for each incorrect response (-1), and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
